title: Medical Assistance Application: Signatures, Authorized Representative and Retroactive Eligibility Date
content:
**Rule.** The Medical Assistance application is the resident's own: it is signed by the resident, an agent under power of attorney or a court-appointed guardian, and the center may act as authorized representative only after the resident or legal representative signs the designation. An application is submitted only after the resident or legal representative has signed it. Eligibility may be requested from the first day of a month up to the retroactive months before the application month when the resident already met the rules then. The requested eligibility date is no earlier than the first day of the month that falls the retroactive months before the application month. Transfers of assets made within the look-back months before the application date are reported on the application. An application still in preparation can be withdrawn only by the resident or legal representative, never by the center.

This rule of Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage uses the product's settings: 3 retroactive months, eligibility beginning on the first day of a month, and a 60-month look-back.

## Before submission: the signature
The signature is shown by the application actions recorded on the case — the request recording who signed it and in what role — not by a caller's statement that it was signed. Without a recorded signature by the resident or legal representative, the application is not submitted.

## The requested eligibility date
The date is compared with the application date on the case record. The earliest permitted date is the first day of the month that falls 3 months before the application month; a date on that day or later is permitted, a date before it is not.

*Hypothetical boundary cases* (application dated 14 June 2031, so the application month is June 2031 and the earliest permitted date is 1 March 2031):

| Requested eligibility date | Within the limit |
|---|---|
| 1 March 2031 | yes — exactly the earliest permitted date |
| 1 April 2031 | yes |
| 1 February 2031 | no — one month earlier than permitted |

## Look-back and withdrawal
Transfers of assets made within the 60 months before the application date are reported on the application. Only the resident or legal representative may withdraw an application still in preparation; the center never does.
